backdoormotion.alias: Backdoor: notify and pulse porch light
backdoormotion.description: Take a backdoor snapshot and notify desktops; between 20:30 and 22:00, also repeat the browser notification and run the existing porch-light fade.

blinkmotion.description: Send the existing Chrome motion notification.

cast_plex_to_chromecast.description: Play the movie 2012 from the Movies library on the Chromecast.

cast_porch_to_chromecast.description: Stream the garage camera to the Chromecast; the legacy script key still contains porch.

cast_downstairs_on_kitchen.description: Cast the default Lovelace view to the kitchen display.

flash.description: Turn the arc lamp on, wait ten seconds, then send its existing turn-off command with a short flash.

frontmotion.description: Take a front-camera snapshot and notify desktops; send browser notifications between 09:05 and 23:00.

garagemotion.description: Take a garage-camera snapshot and notify desktops; send browser notifications between 09:05 and 23:00.

kk.description: Call shell_command.kk with the existing crossed selector mapping: pla receives input_select.sta and sta receives input_select.pla.

kkk.description: Play the radio selector value on the player selected by input_select.player using the existing TUNEIN media type.

turn_off_lg_tv_screen.alias: Living room TV: turn screen off
turn_off_lg_tv_screen.description: Send the webOS screen-off command to the living room 77-inch TV without changing the existing power behavior.

turn_on_lg_tv_screen.alias: Living room TV: turn screen on
turn_on_lg_tv_screen.description: Send the webOS screen-on command to the living room 77-inch TV.

turn_off_lg2_tv_screen.description: Send the webOS screen-off command to the LG2 TV.

turn_on_lg2_tv_screen.description: Send the webOS screen-on command to the LG2 TV.

living_room_tv_picture_energy_saving.alias: Living room TV: request energy-saving setting
living_room_tv_picture_energy_saving.description: Show the existing webOS confirmation alert whose OK button applies the supplied energy-saving setting.

mediaoff.description: Turn off the eight retained household media players in sequence, continuing when an individual player fails.

notify.description: Send a timestamped message to the Roomba, iMac and Chrome notification targets.

notifymax.alias: Notifications: send desktop and persistent message
notifymax.description: Send a timestamped message to the Roomba, iMac and Chrome targets and create a persistent Home Assistant notification.

notify_mqtt.description: Publish a correctly escaped JSON message to the existing retained MQTT notification topic; queue simultaneous calls.

notify_mqtt_log.alias: Notifications: publish retained MQTT switch log
notify_mqtt_log.description: Publish the supplied message to living_room/switch_log with retention enabled.

playplexplaylist.alias: Living room Echo: play Dark Side of the Moon
playplexplaylist.description: Request the Dark Side of the Moon album through AMAZON_MUSIC on the living room Echo; this script has no playback timeout.

run_playlist_on_plex_ants.description: Play the Ants Plex playlist on the Android TV Chromecast with repeat-all enabled.

run_playlist_on_plex_mobile_ants.description: Play the Ants Plex playlist on the dining room speaker with repeat-all enabled.

run_playlist_on_plex_bathroom_ants.description: Play the Ants Plex playlist on the bathroom speaker with repeat-all enabled.

stopplexplaylist.description: Stop media playback on the living room Echo.

random_on_an2.description: Invoke the existing shell_command.random_on_an2 helper; its implementation remains in the main configuration.

random_on_inew.description: Invoke the existing shell_command.random_on_inew helper; its implementation remains in the main configuration.

receiver_turn_off.description: Send PowerOff to the Pioneer AV Receiver through Harmony with the original 0.6-second command delay.

receiver_turn_on.alias: Receiver: power on and select CD
receiver_turn_on.description: Send PowerOn followed by InputCd to the Pioneer AV Receiver through Harmony with the original 0.6-second command delay.

receiver_surround.description: Send the existing SR+ command to the Pioneer AV Receiver through Harmony.

receiver_surrmodestereo.description: Send the existing Stereo command to the Pioneer AV Receiver through Harmony.

receiver_surroundmodelogic7.description: Send the existing SurroundModeLogic7 command to the Pioneer AV Receiver through Harmony.

receiver_inputtuner.description: Send InputTuner to the Pioneer AV Receiver through Harmony.

receiver_inputcd.description: Send InputCd to the Pioneer AV Receiver through Harmony.

receiver_inputtape.description: Send InputTape to the Pioneer AV Receiver through Harmony.

tv_pic.alias: Living room TV: open front-camera snapshot
tv_pic.description: Open the front-camera snapshot URL with the webOS launcher.

tv_pic2.alias: Living room TV: notify with front-camera snapshot
tv_pic2.description: Send the front-camera message and snapshot icon through the registered living-room LG TV notifier.

tv_pic3.alias: Living room TV: play REN channel
tv_pic3.description: Play the existing REN channel name on the living room TV, preserving the provider-facing Cyrillic identifier.

tv_pic4.description: Play channel identifier 1 on the living room TV.

resetcreebulb.description: Run the existing six-on/five-off power-cycle sequence and timings on the reset switch, leaving it on.

run_playlist_on_plex.alias: Living room display: play Mult playlist
run_playlist_on_plex.description: Play the Mult Plex playlist on the living room display with shuffle enabled.

run_playlist_on_plex_hub.alias: Family Hub: request Sailor through Alexa
run_playlist_on_plex_hub.description: Send the existing custom Alexa request for the Caboomers Sailor track to the Family Hub.

run_playlist_on_plex_hubold.alias: Family Hub: play Sailor directly from Plex
run_playlist_on_plex_hubold.description: Play the existing Caboomers Sailor track selection from the Plex Music library on the Family Hub with shuffle enabled.

shutdown_inew.description: Invoke the existing shell_command.shutdown_inew helper to shut down its configured host.

living_room_display_2_temperature.alias: Living room display 2: ask porch temperature
living_room_display_2_temperature.description: Send the existing custom Google voice request for the porch temperature to living room display 2.

turn_off_living_room.alias: Household: turn off lights and media power
turn_off_living_room.description: Turn off the original multi-room light and switch lists, then invoke the iNew host shutdown helper.

tv_random_channel.description: Send digits for a random channel from 30 through 1214 to the LG TV through Harmony with a 0.4-second delay.

tv_random_channel_p.description: Send digits for a random channel from 1216 through 1399 to the LG TV through Harmony with a 0.4-second delay.

tv_random_channel2.alias: Living room TV: send random channel digits
tv_random_channel2.description: Send four independently generated digits using the original exclusive range bounds and 0.1-second Harmony delay.

tv_type.alias: Living room TV: send legacy test keys
tv_type.description: Send the fixed Harmony key sequence 1, A, S, D, A to the LG TV.

tv_type2.alias: Living room TV: insert legacy test text
tv_type2.description: Insert the literal text 123 through the existing webOS input-method command with replace set to zero.

volume_down.description: Set the retained Echo volume preset to 20 percent.

play_kodi_channel.alias: Kodi: play selected channel using legacy lookup
play_kodi_channel.description: Resolve the selected channel against the JSON channel catalogue; stop without playback if the catalogue is missing or the selection is ambiguous.

your_kodi_script.description: Forward the supplied channel ID unchanged to the existing Kodi player.
